cohort: 2,128 patients who delivered at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Patna, Bihar, India, between April 1, 2016, and March 31, 2019
finding: Robson's group 5 (34.97%) was the major contributor to the overall cesarean section rate (38.16%), followed by group 2 (26.35%), group 1 (15.51%), and group 10 (7.14%).
